expectations.text: Schema is built with versioned<V1>('...').next<V2>(...) chained fluently with no .build() call, matching the real @skewkit/core API
expectations.evidence: weekly-content.schema.ts:69-80 — versioned<WeeklyContentV1>('weekly-content').next<WeeklyContentV2>('rename themeQuote...', fn); no .build(); matches the real fluent API exactly.

expectations.text: Migration steps close over frozen snapshot interfaces (V1/V2 declared in the schema file), not the live application WeeklyContent type
expectations.evidence: Private WeeklyContentV1/WeeklyContentV2 interfaces with explicit 'FROZEN SNAPSHOTS' comments; the live model is only mentioned as needing structural compatibility, never imported. WeeklyContentDraft is an alias of the V2 snapshot.

expectations.text: Storage uses createVersionedStore with webStorageDriver('local') and passes buildId
expectations.evidence: draft-store.ts:44-48 — createVersionedStore(WeeklyContentSchema, { driver: webStorageDriver('local'), buildId: BUILD_ID, onReadFailure }).

expectations.text: Read path branches on the discriminated result: checks result.ok and switches on result.reason covering 'ahead', 'gap', 'invalid', and 'threw'
expectations.evidence: draft-store.ts:79-110 — checks result.ok, then switch(result.reason) with explicit cases for 'ahead', 'invalid', and 'gap'/'threw'; uses real result fields (result.value, result.migratedFrom).

expectations.text: 'ahead' is handled distinctly from 'invalid' — newer-build drafts are refetched or left untouched, never discarded or treated as corrupt
expectations.evidence: 'ahead' returns status 'newer-build' with the draft explicitly LEFT IN STORAGE and doc-comment telling callers to refetch from server; only 'invalid' discards. deleteDraft() docs warn never to call it on an ahead read.

expectations.text: No JSON.parse(raw) as WeeklyContent style unchecked cast remains in the read path
expectations.evidence: All reads go through store.get()/store.peek(); no JSON.parse or type assertion casts anywhere in the read path.
